status: PROPOSED, not in db/release-manifest.json. Fauzan approved building the guard pay run on 5 Nov 2026 (third audit, item 1: "Build"). Installing it needs his separate approval and goes through the release path and its migration window (run-db-migration.sh, CEO-run). This file does not install anything.

modules.switch: None separate: the API detects prima.guard_pay_runs and prima.guard_pay_advances (wage advances), prima.guard_loans (advance and loan scheme) and prima.statutory_versions (statutory rates the CEO sets), Fauzan 6 Nov 2026. It also adds a read-only pay_read policy on the pay formulas module's tables so HR can prepare pay. Before the install the Guard pay screen shows no runs and preparing one is refused with a plain message. Paying from Prima is a further switch: rule PAY-GUARD primaPays stays off (trial beside the JA Group app) until Fauzan picks the switch date. Payroll Finance has a statutory_read wall for SELECT on statutory_versions only; it does not grant ACT, pay_read, employee-data access or statutory writes.
modules.rollback: Revoke INSERT, UPDATE on prima.guard_pay_runs, prima.guard_pay_advances and prima.guard_loans from prima_app (the screen goes read-only and preparing fails). Keep the tables: pay runs and advances are pay records and their history is in the audit log.
